purpose: Test whether independent SFEB oracles reject seeded implementation and evidence failures while accepting semantics-preserving changes.
execution_boundary: Apply these mutations only to disposable local benchmark fixtures. Never mutate production source, real user data, or a public service.
scoring_rule: A mutation is killed only when the independent evaluator rejects the resulting run for the expected reason. Agent self-reports and schema-only checks do not count as detection.

mutations.mutation: Replace a required form submit handler with a no-op while leaving the control visually enabled.
Change a required in-app route target so that the visible navigation control opens the wrong page.
Keep a stale connected status after the WebSocket has entered Closing or Closed.
Leave the loading indicator active after a failed asynchronous request and expose no retry action.
Remove the accessible name or programmatic label from a task-critical input.
Introduce a keyboard trap or remove keyboard reachability from a task-critical control.
Remove the live-region announcement for a task-critical asynchronous state change.
Add a fixed minimum width that causes horizontal page overflow below the declared mobile viewport.
Hide a required action at the mobile breakpoint without providing an accessible alternative.
Create a collision or clipped control only at an intermediate width between the fixed reference viewports.
Allow a role-restricted state transition to execute for a fixture user lacking the required permission.
Add an unapproved external fetch or image/script dependency to a fixture expected to be network-closed.
Change screenshot bytes after capture without updating the artifact digest.
Reuse a receipt from the parent source revision after the implementation commit changes.
Record a CSS viewport or device scale factor inconsistent with the PNG pixel dimensions.
Omit the accessibility-tree artifact while retaining a nominal success result.
Copy a valid receipt across two different fixture IDs or task IDs.
Delete a requirement and its local assertion from the implementation contract while the frozen product brief still requires it.
Hard-code layout behavior for the five visible viewport widths while breaking unseen widths between them.
Return placeholder or empty content while satisfying a weak screenshot-only check.

positive_controls.transformation: Reformat Rust source without changing the compiled program or rendered interface.
Rename a private local variable without changing public API or behavior.
Insert a semantically neutral wrapper element that preserves computed layout, accessibility semantics and interaction behavior.
Replace a CSS literal with an equivalent design-token alias that produces the same computed style.
Activate the same supported control by keyboard instead of pointer and reach the same contract-defined state.

metamorphic_relations.name: pointer-keyboard equivalence
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Execute the same supported journey using pointer events and keyboard events.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Both traces reach the same contract-defined terminal state and expose equivalent result semantics.

metamorphic_relations.name: deep-link navigation equivalence
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Reach a route via in-app navigation and via direct URL entry or refresh.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Both paths render the same route identity and contract-defined persistent state.

metamorphic_relations.name: responsive continuity
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Sweep widths between declared desktop, tablet and mobile reference widths.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Required content and controls remain present, readable and operable; no overflow or collision is introduced.

metamorphic_relations.name: semantics-preserving source refactor
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Apply a refactor declared to preserve component behavior and accessibility semantics.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Contract journeys, semantic roles, accessible names and interaction outcomes remain unchanged.

metamorphic_relations.name: receipt identity stability
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Re-run an unchanged fixture and implementation with a new run ID but identical pinned inputs.
metamorphic_relations.invariant: Source, fixture and environment identities remain the same while run-scoped receipt identity and artifact digests are internally consistent.

reporting_requirements: Report every mutation and positive control individually with expected and observed disposition.
Report denominators and numerators per class and severity; do not hide unexecuted cases.
Retain exact task, fixture, source, browser, evaluator and environment digests.
A mutation counts as killed only when the evaluator rejects it for the relevant independent oracle, not merely because a build fails for an unrelated reason.
A positive control counts as accepted only when all required positive assertions still execute.
Do not pool this public-pilot campaign with private hidden-holdout benchmark scores.
